subject.title: [Bug][iOS] chat.history reconciliation duplicates and reorders replies after tool runs

question: Is the shipped Gateway trace and source-level race sufficient to authorize a native-chat fix, or must the exact failure first be captured in a deterministic replay or device/simulator run?
rationale: The bug and likely boundary are clear, but the current evidence does not isolate which of overlapping refresh scheduling, stale response application, identity adoption, sequence ordering, or tool projection causes the final corrupt UI state.

options.title: Require deterministic pre-fix proof
options.body: Capture the failure with a controlled delayed-history replay or a device/simulator trace before changing reconciliation logic.

options.title: Authorize bounded implementation now
options.body: Allow an owner-led fix from the existing trace, provided the PR adds the delayed out-of-order regression and after-fix native proof.

recommendation.title: Require deterministic pre-fix proof
recommendation.body: Capture the failure with a controlled delayed-history replay or a device/simulator trace before changing reconciliation logic.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the most recent broad history-ordering refactor and proposed the deterministic mobile replay direction.
